en.t: The most important property in my agent pipeline is the least interesting one to talk about.
en.d: It is idempotent ingestion. Running the same job twice produces the same result as running it once. Nobody puts that on a slide. It does not demo well. But it is the reason the pipeline is still running, and I want to explain why it matters more with agents than it ever did with scheduled jobs. A traditional pipeline runs on a schedule you control.
